English: Spindle Stand
A humble structure of woven branches and hides, providing the nomads a place for basic thread spinning. Boosts early textile efforts and supports population growth among the clan.
Weavers Bench
A slightly more advanced, yet portable, bench for skilled weavers. Allows more efficient thread production, benefiting the hordes manpower and unity.
Loom Hut
A sturdy seasonal hut, roofed with birch bark, housing a large communal loom. Enables the clan to produce cloth for trade and clothing, growing population and manpower.
Threading Pavilion
A spacious, semi-permanent yurt for advanced weaving and dyeing, enabling greater textile production and trade. Attracts new families and skilled workers to the horde.
Dyehouse
A permanent log structure with stone vats for dyeing cloth in bulk, producing vibrant textiles and expanding the clans trading influence.
Patterned Loom Room
A specialized timber hall for master weavers to create intricate patterned cloth. Encourages population growth, economic prosperity, and cultural prestige.
Fine Weavers Hall
A large, decorated hall for the most skilled weavers, who produce luxury textiles for the ruling elite. Highly increases horde capacity and tax income.
Textile Chamber
A fortified chamber, well-protected and climate-controlled, where master artisans develop innovations in weaving and dyeing, greatly benefitting the clans growth and wealth.
Cloth Guildhall
An imposing timber structure serving as the center for all weaving activity and guild organization, hosting trade negotiations and supporting the rapid expansion of the horde.
Slavic Grand Weaver Guild

The legendary heart of East Slavic textile mastery: a sprawling guild complex that draws traders, artisans, and the curious from across the steppe, cementing the clans dominance in economy and culture.
